name: cool_diffuse
prompt: Fixed front camera view of a compact yellow SO-101 robot arm on a gray tabletop. The robot carries one small blue cube from a white taped three-by-three grid and places it on a green square pad to the left of the grid. Keep the same camera framing, robot parts, blue cube, green pad, table markings, object positions, and arm movement as the input video. Realistic plastic and metal materials. Soft neutral-cool overhead LED light at 5500 kelvin illuminates the scene evenly, with slightly cooler white balance and gentle shadows. The blue cube remains blue and the pad remains green.
negative_prompt: The video captures a game playing, with bad crappy graphics and cartoonish frames. It represents a recording of old outdated games. The lighting looks very fake. The textures are very raw and basic. The geometries are very primitive. The images are very pixelated and of poor CG quality. There are many subtitles in the footage. Overall, the video is unrealistic at all.
